precedence: D children > C not-WHO-group-1 > B add-on > A monotherapy, applied in that order and stated rather than discovered. A different precedence would move trials between readings and these counts would change.
what_an_empty_reading_means: A reading with NO eligible trial is not a review, it is an EMPTY QUESTION, and the honest outcome is to name it as a BOUNDARY on the other readings' pages rather than to build a page with nothing on it. A reading with ONE UNCONTROLLED trial IS a review and publishes a sourced verdict.
